authority: User replaced the transcript-marker workflow with YouTube playthrough review and a free-form removal list, including conversation options; latest pilot scope is two quests.
accepted_item_types: explicit all-Johnny-dialogue request for a named quest
suggested_note_fields: video URL and timestamp if available

quote_matching.user_quote: At least five consecutive words copied from a spoken line's transcript.
quote_matching.short_options: If a conversation option has fewer than five words, copy its complete displayed label.
quote_matching.identification: Include the quest name and speaker, or identify the entry as OPTION. A timestamp is optional unless needed to resolve multiple matches.
quote_matching.scope: A quote identifies the full spoken event or option requested for removal; a partial-wording cut must be specified separately.
quote_matching.ambiguity: Do not assume five words uniquely identify an occurrence. Resolve duplicates against scene/branch context before selecting an exact edit.
quote_matching.short_spoken_lines: If a spoken line has fewer than five words, copy the complete line.

selection_rule: Explicit user removal requests in the returned notes select candidate cuts. Blank fields, unchecked suggestions and template examples select nothing.
option_and_spoken_reply: Map the menu choice and any spoken event separately. Selecting one does not silently select the other or its entire downstream branch; an explicit both/whole-exchange request expands the proposal for review.
matching: Resolve notes to exact spoken-event or choice IDs, source providers/hashes, branches and both V wording variants using the selected Step 2 index and source evidence.
uncertainty: Hold ambiguous matches, unseen branches, mixed-purpose lines and unclear cut boundaries for review; video absence is not proof that an option or line does not exist.
implementation_constraint: Review progression, outcomes, acknowledgements, rewards, timing and exits before any option or dialogue change. A blocked path requires a specific reviewed adaptation.
supersedes: The five-quest J5-03 document and its (remove)-after-ID workflow as the current pilot assignment. Prior documents and decisions remain preserved.
preferred_note_format: Quest title as a heading, followed by speaker-prefixed quotes: Johnny: ..., V: ..., OPTION: ...

format_example.text: Johnny: I'd recognize that mug anywhere
